name: FortiGate — Unauthorized Internal Port Scan / Network Reconnaissance
description:
Attacker objective
Map internal services to find lateral-movement or exploitation targets (attacker recon, worm, or compromised host).

Attack logic
An internal source contacting a large number of distinct destination ports in a short window is port-scanning. Approved vulnerability scanners are excluded; other high-cardinality sources are surfaced to verify.

Why this detection works
Counting distinct destination ports per source distinguishes vertical scanning from normal service use.

False positives
Additional authorised vulnerability-management hosts.

Tuning
Add verified scanner IPs to the exclusion after confirming them against the vuln-management inventory.

Required telemetry
FortiGate traffic logs (source.ip, destination.port, srccountry).
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. source.ip = the scanner; verify against the approved vuln-management inventory.
2. If not approved, treat as attacker recon or a worm and isolate the host.
